0A2K: Kar = having done. Simar = remembering. Aroga = healthy.
(O brother! In the early hours) bathing and remembering the Name of your Prabhu, mind and body become healthy,
After taking your cleansing bath, remember your God in meditation, and your mind and body shall be free of disease.
After taking bath, remember you your Lord, thus soul and body shall be disease free.
Bathe and remember your Prabhu, for you have become well in mind and body.
TUUK: Kot = millions. Bighan = obstacles (on life's path). Pragte = come to light. Bhale sanjoga = good chances of union with Prabhu. ||1||
(because) in Prabhu's shelter millions of obstacles (on the path of life) are taken away, and good chances of union with Prabhu come to light. ||1||
Millions of obstacles are removed, in the Sanctuary of God, and good fortune dawns. ||1||
In the Lord's refuge millions of obstacles are removed and good fortune dawns.
Being in Prabhu's shelter, millions of obstacles have been removed, and good karma has come to light. ||1||
G9LP: Prabh bani = the Bani of Prabhu's praise. Subhakhia = beautifully spoken.
O brother! (The Guru's) Word is beautifully spoken; (this Word) is the Bani of Prabhu's praise.
The Word of God's Bani, and His Shabad, are the best utterances.
The Lord's discourse and the words are the best utterances.
When, through the Guru's teaching, we spoke Prabhu's praise in Bani —
4U4S: Bhai = O brother! Too = you. Gur poorai = by the perfect Guru. Rakhia = saved (from the obstacles of life). ||Rahau||
Keep singing, hearing and reading (this Word) always; (if you keep making this effort, be sure that) the perfect Guru has saved you (from the obstacles that come in life). ||Rahau||
So constantly sing them, listen to them, and read them, O Siblings of Destiny, and the Perfect Guru shall save you. ||Pause||
Ever sing hear and recite them, O brother and the Perfect Guru shall save you. Pause.
O brother! By this the perfect Guru has saved you from the fever; so you too, set Vahiguru's Name in raag and sing it, hear it and read it. ||Rahau||
LKNP: Saacha = lasting forever. Amit = {mit = measure, limit} whose measure cannot be told. Vachhal = loving.
O brother! The Master Prabhu lasts forever; His greatness cannot be measured; He loves devotion; He is the source of mercy.
The glorious greatness of the True Lord is immeasurable; the Merciful Lord is the Lover of His devotees.
Immeasurable is the greatness of the True Lord He, the Merciful Master is the Lover of his saints.
The True Master's greatness is vast, and He is the beloved of His devotees.
YHPZ: Paij = honour. Aad = from the beginning. Birad = age-old nature. ||2||
He has always been keeping the honour of His saints; He has kept this age-old nature of His from the very beginning. ||2||
He has preserved the honor of His Saints; from the very beginning of time, His Nature is to cherish them. ||2||
He has been preserving the honour of His saints and to cherish them is he innate nature, since the beginning of Time.
He has always kept the honour of the saints, and from the beginning He has kept His vow. ||2||
7P8C: Amrit = giving spiritual life. Bhunchahu = eat. Mukh = in the mouth.
O brother! Parmatma's Name gives spiritual life; keep eating this (spiritual) food always, keep putting it in your mouth at every moment.
So eat the Ambrosial Name of the Lord as your food; put it into your mouth at all times.
God's Nectar-Name ever eat you as food and put it into your mouth at al times.
So eat the food of the nectar of Hari's Name every day — put it in your mouth at all times, meaning remember the Name every moment.
FHX0: Jara = old age (of the spiritual life). Mara = death. Taap = pain and trouble. ||3||
O brother! Keep singing Gobind's virtues always; (your spiritual life) will know neither old age nor death, and every pain and trouble will go away. ||3||
The pains of old age and death shall all depart, when you constantly sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe. ||3||
Every day hymn you the praise of the Lord of the world, and the pains of old age and death shall all flee away.
Know that (jara) old age, (mara) death and every fever have (naatha) fled; so sing Gobind's virtues every day. ||3||
KF8B: Suami merai = by my Master. Sarab kala = all strength, all power (to face the 'millions of obstacles'). Ban aaee = arises.
O brother! (Whoever takes the support of the Guru's Word and chants Prabhu's Name —) my Master hears their prayer, and full strength (to face millions of obstacles) arises (within them).
My Lord and Master has heard my prayer, and all my affairs have been resolved.
My Master has heard my supplication, and all my affairs have been adjusted.
When my Master heard the prayer, all power came into me.
SPQN: Sagle jug antar = in all the ages, always. Gur Nanak ki = O Nanak! of the Guru. ||4||11||
O Nanak! This greatness of the Guru stays plainly shown in all the ages. ||4||11||
The glorious greatness of Guru Nanak is manifest, throughout all the ages. ||4||11||
Your glory of Guru Nanak, has become manifest all the ages through.
Sri Guru ji says: the Guru's greatness has been made plain through all the ages. ||4||11|| ☬ Mahadev ji, brother of Sri Guru Arjan Dev ji, makes a request to Sri Guru Arjan Sahib ji:

17XE: Kirpal = merciful. Govinda = Parmatma. Sagal = all. Manorath = the mind's wishes.
O brother! The person on whom the Guru, the form of Parmatma, is merciful has all their mind's wishes fulfilled (because)
The Guru, the Lord of the Universe, became merciful to me, and I obtained all of my mind's desires.
When the Great Lord of the World become merciful, I obtained all the desires of my heart.
When the Guru, the form of Gobind, became merciful, then all the aims of the mind, such as knowledge of the self, were gained.
XA13: singing and singing the songs of Parmatma's praise and holding fast to Prabhu's feet, that person stops wavering (before the attacks of Maya). ||1||
I have become stable and steady, touching the Lord's Feet, and singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe. ||1||
Touching the Lord's feet and singing the Master's praise I have become eternal.
And having fallen at Hari's feet and sung Gobind's virtues, they have become steady. ||1||
SCK0: Bhalo = good. Poora = auspicious. S moorat = that moment.
(O brother! In a person's life) that moment is lovely and auspicious,
It is a good time, a perfectly auspicious time.
It is a good and wholly auspicious time.
That moment is good and complete,
75XT: Sahaj = spiritual steadiness. Jap = chanting. Vaje = began to sound. Anhad = unstruck, unbroken. Toora = musical instruments. ||1|| Rahau ||
when, through chanting Parmatma's Name, the unbroken instruments of peace, spiritual steadiness and bliss play within them. ||1|| Rahau ||
I am in celestial peace, tranquility and ecstasy, chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord; the unstruck melody of the sound current vibrates and resounds. ||1||Pause||
When by uttering the Lord's Name, I attain peace, composure and happiness and unstruck melody rings within me. Pause.
the moment in which, chanting the Name, peace and the bliss of knowledge were found, and the unstruck instruments of the Name have played. ||1|| Rahau ||
YW0A: O brother! The person who meets their Master, the Beloved Prabhu ji — to them these homes and places seem to give comfort.
Meeting with my Beloved Lord and Master, my home has become a mansion filled with happiness.
On meeting the Lord, my Beloved, my home and mansion have become comfortable.
We have met our Master, our Beloved, and home and temple have become places of comfort — or: we have met our beloved Master, the giver of comfort, within the home, that is, in the heart.
VC9C: O servant Nanak! The person who has found the treasure of Parmatma's Name has every wish fulfilled. ||2||8||36||
Servant Nanak has attained the treasure of the Lord's Name; all his desires have been fulfilled. ||2||8||36||
Servant Nanak has attained the treasure of God's Name and all his heart's desires are fulfilled.

I have been blessed with peace, pleasure, bliss, and the celestial sound current, gazing upon the feet of God.
Beholding the Lord's feet, I am blessed with comfort, bliss, salvation and celestial melody.

Comfort in the body and joy in the mind, and then, of itself, the voice that brings well-being is heard — meaning the Guru is giving the teaching that brings liberation. When did this happen? When we (niharia) saw the Guru's feet.
82DP: Rakhanhaarai = by the One able to protect. Satgur = by the True Guru. ||1||

Repairing to the True Guru's protection, I am saved.

WNAJ: O brother! Those who take that Guru's shelter are saved (from the obstacles on the path of spiritual life),
I have been saved, in the True Guru's Sanctuary;
The Guru is such, whose service goes not in vain. Pause.
Coming into the True Guru's shelter, those people have been (ubre) freed.
99TW: Ja ki = of which (Guru). Birthi = empty. ||Rahau||
— the Guru whose service never goes empty (take His shelter). ||Rahau||
service to Him does not go in vain. ||1||Pause||

The (sev) toil done for Him does not go in vain. ||Rahau||

There is peace within the home of one's heart, and there is peace outside as well, when God becomes kind and compassionate.
When one's Lord becomes merciful, there is joy at home and again there is joy abroad too.
Now there is comfort at home and comfort outside too, because our able True Guru has become merciful.
J4VJ: O Nanak! No obstacle comes on that person's path through life; Parmatma stays merciful to them. ||2||12||40||
O Nanak, no obstacles block my way; my God has become gracious and merciful to me. ||2||12||40||
Nanak, no obstacle befalls me since my Master has become merciful to me.
Sri Guru ji says: now no obstacle touches, because my able Guru has become merciful. ||2||12||40||
4XBK: Kales = sufferings of the mind. Sabh = all. Prabh = by Prabhu.
O brother! Whoever the beloved Prabhu shows kindness to has all their troubles and diseases taken away.
My sufferings have come to an end, and all diseases have been eradicated.
My Lord has extended His mercy, so my sufferings are past and my afflictions are all obliterated.
O my Prabhu! When You showed grace, all our troubles went, and all our diseases fled too.
FN6Y: Aath pahar = always, at every moment, all day. Ghaal = toil. Hamari = ours, of us beings. ||1||
(O brother!) Keep remembering the Master Prabhu all eight watches of the day; this toil of ours (surely) bears fruit. ||1||

All the eight watches through, I contemplate over my Lord and fruitful has become my toil.

9C8N: O Prabhu ji! You alone give me the wealth and capital of spiritual bliss.
O Dear Lord, You are my peace, wealth and capital.
O reverend Master, You are my bliss, wealth and capital.
O Hari ji! You alone are the capital of our comfort and wealth.
2PL3: Bhai = O brother! O Prabhu! Mere kau = me. ||Rahau||

Please, save me, O my Beloved! I offer this prayer to my God. ||Pause||
I pray to Lord! "Save me, O Loved One".

1SM4: Maagau = I ask. Paavau = I receive. Bharosa = support.
O brother! Whatever I ask (from Prabhu), that I receive. I have (full) trust in my Master Prabhu.
Whatever I ask for, I receive; I have total faith in my Master.
What-so-ever I ask, that yea all that I receive, for I have faith in my Master.
Now whatever I ask for, that I receive, because I trust my Master.
4LXR: Nanak says: the person who meets the perfect Guru has all their worries and anxieties taken away. ||2||14||42||
Says Nanak, I have met with the Perfect Guru, and all my fears have been dispelled. ||2||14||42||
Says Nanak, I have met with my Perfect Guru, and all my fears are dispelled.

W029: Simar simar = remembering again and again. Sagla = all.

By remembering and remembering our revered True Guru, we have wiped away all suffering.
1ECN: Gur bachni = walking by the Guru's words. ||1||
Walking by the Guru's words, all their troubles and all their diseases go away; they gain the fruits their mind desires. ||1||

By Guru's holy word the fever and other afflictions are past and I have obtained my heart desired fruits.
The three fevers and all diseases have gone through the Guru's words; we have gained the fruits the mind desired. ||1||
8CVP: O brother! My Guru is full of every virtue; He gives every comfort.
My Perfect Guru is the Giver of peace.
My Perfect Guru is the Giver of peace.
My perfect Guru alone is the giver of comfort.
AB6U: Karan karan = the root of the world. Samrath = Master of all powers. Bidhata = Creator. ||Rahau||
The Guru is the form of that all-pervading Creator who is the root of the whole world and the Master of all powers. ||Rahau||
He is the Doer, the Cause of causes, the Almighty Lord and Master, the Perfect Primal Lord, the Architect of Destiny. ||Pause||
He is the Doer of deeds, the Omnipotent Master and the Perfect Creator Lord. Pause.
What is the perfect Guru like? He is the very form of Vahiguru — the Master able to bring about all causes, the perfect Being, the giver of the fruit of deeds. ||Rahau||
00YJ: O Nanak! (Say: O brother! If) the True Guru has been merciful (to you), keep singing the songs of Prabhu's praise; (through the blessing of praise) bliss, joy and comfort will stay (within you).

Make You merry, revel, and sing Lord's praise and excellences for, Guru Nanak has become compassionate to you.

6XP3: Jai jai kar = glory. Bheetar = in. ||2||15||43||
(Through praise) one gains glory in the world. (One stays sure that) Parmatma is (always overhead as) the protector. ||2||15||43||

The Lord God Himself has rid the whole world of its sins and has saved it.
O brother! The able Hari has taken away our past sin, and He Himself has kept us safe from the whole world.
JT8U: Parbrahm = by Parbrahm. Birad = age-old nature. Samaria = has kept in mind. ||1||
— the person on whom Parbrahm Prabhu cast (a glance of) grace. Prabhu always keeps His age-old nature (of mercy and love) in mind. ||1||

52L2: Raje Ram ki = of Ram the King, of Prabhu the Sovereign. Rakhvali = protection, help.
O brother! (The person whom) Prabhu the Sovereign protects (from sins) —
I have attained the Protective Sanctuary of the Lord, my King.
I have attained the refuge of Lord, the King.
The grace of Ram the King has come upon us as our protection.
CDBP: Sahaj = spiritual steadiness. Sukhali = at ease. ||Rahau||
their mind is at ease and their body is at ease. (O brother! You too) keep singing the songs of Parmatma's praise; (you too) will find comfort and the bliss of spiritual steadiness. ||Rahau||
In celestial peace and ecstasy, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and my mind, body and being are at peace. ||Pause||

O brother! My Guru saves those caught in vices (from their vices). I too have His support (alone).
My True Guru is the Savior of sinners; I have placed my trust and faith in Him.
The saviour of the sinners is my True Guru and in him, I have placed my reliance.
My True Guru is the saviour of sinners; so I have His (bharvasa) support alone.
2YXW: The everlasting Master who has forgiven all beings (by bringing them to the Guru's shelter) — that Prabhu hears Nanak's plea too. ||2||17||45||

Listening to Nanak's supplications, the True Lord has pardoned all his sins.

Z0KE: O brother! (The servant to whom) Parbrahm Parmeshar showed grace — He took away all their diseases.

The Supreme Lord, the Primal Being, has forgiven and all the ailments are removed.
O brother! Parbrahm Parmeshar has taken away all diseases from Sri Guru Hargobind Sahib ji and blessed him.
X0HC: Those who take the Guru's shelter are saved from pain and trouble. The Guru sets all their affairs right. ||1||
Those who come to the Sanctuary of the True Guru are saved, and all their affairs are resolved. ||1||
They, who enter the sanctuary of the Perfect Guru, are saved and all their affairs are resolved.
We have been saved by being in the shelter of the perfect Guru; the True Guru alone has set all our affairs right. ||1||
QYTV: Jan = by the servant. Adhar = on the support.
O brother! The servant of Parmatma who has remembered Parmatma's Name (and has made their way) on the support of the Name —
The Lord's humble servant meditates in remembrance on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; this is his only support.
God's slave remembers the name, which is the support.
I, the servant, have remembered Hari's Name, which is the (adhar) ground of all.
J3W0: the perfect Guru, in His grace, has taken down (their) fever. ||Rahau||
The Perfect True Guru extended His Mercy, and the fever has been dispelled. ||Pause||
Extending his mercy, the Perfect Guru, has cured the fever. Pause.
Because of this the perfect True Guru, showing His grace, has taken down the fever. ||Rahau||
5137: Karah = we make. Piare = O beloved! Gur = by the Guru.
O my beloved (brother)! (Taking the Guru's shelter) we (too) enjoy bliss always. It is the Guru who has saved Hargobind (from the fever).
So celebrate and be happy, my beloveds - the Guru has saved Hargobind.
My dear ones ever make merry for my Guru has saved Hargobind.
O my beloved ones! We are always in bliss, because the Guru has saved Hargobind ji from the fever.
5P4Z: Karte ki = of the Creator. Saach = everlasting. Sat = true, right. Bhakhia = spoke. ||2||18||46||

O Nanak! The Creator is the Master of great powers. One should speak (only) the Word of praise of that everlasting Prabhu. (The Guru has) spoken this true word (given the right teaching). ||2||18||46||
Great is the glorious greatness of the Creator, O Nanak; True is the Word of His Shabad, and True is the sermon of His Teachings. ||2||18||46||
Great is the greatness of the Creator, True is His word and true His discourse, O Nanak.

AQ75: Santahu = O saints! Dhiai = may I meditate.
O saints! (Pray that) I may always keep remembering Parmatma's Name.
O Saints, meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.
O saints, I ponder over the Lord's God's Name.
O saints! We have become ones who meditate on the Name Har Har.
SGFR: Saagar = ocean. Visrau nahi = {imperative future, third person, singular (see 'Gurbani Viakaran')} may He not be forgotten. Chindiarra = thought of, wished for. Paaee = may I receive. ||1|| Rahau ||
May Parmatma, the ocean of comfort, never be forgotten by me; may I keep receiving (from His door) the fruit my mind wishes for. ||1|| Rahau ||
Never forget God, the ocean of peace; thus you shall obtain the fruits of your mind's desires. ||1||Pause||
I forget not the Lord, the Ocean of happiness, and obtain my heart desired fruits. Pause.
Prabhu, the ocean of comfort, is never forgotten by us; by this we have gained the fruits our mind wished for, one after another. ||1|| Rahau ||
A61S: O saints! The perfect Guru has taken away (the child Hargobind's) fever; the Guru has shown His grace.

Extending his mercy, the Perfect True Guru has cured the fever.
The perfect True Guru has shown such grace that Hargobind's fever has been taken away.
KP1P: Parmatma has been merciful; the suffering of the whole family has been wiped away. ||1||
The Supreme Lord God has become kind and compassionate, and my whole family is now free of pain and suffering. ||1||
The Transcendent Lord Master has become merciful and the entire family, is rid off the malady.
The able Parbrahm has been so merciful to us that the suffering of everyone in the family has been wiped away. ||1||
H8FF: O saints! Parmatma's Name alone is (our) support; the Name alone is the treasure of every joy, taste and beauty.
The Treasure of absolute joy, sublime elixir and beauty, the Name of the Lord is my only Support.
I have the prop of God's Name which is the treasure of all the joy, Nectar and beauty.
We have taken as our support Hari's Name, the home of all treasures and the very form of bliss and joy.
KF4K: Pat = honour. Parmesar = by Parmeshar. Sabh = all. Udharia = saved. ||2||20||48||

Nanak, the Supreme Lord has preserved my honour, and the whole world is saved.

YFF3: O brother! My Guru has become (my) helper,

My True Guru is not my saviour.

Showering us with His Mercy and Grace, God extended His Hand, and saved Hargobind, who is now safe and secure. ||1||Pause||

He has shown such grace that He has given His hand and saved Hargobind; so he has become (nava niroa) fresh and well — that is, hale and hearty. ||1|| Rahau ||

The fever is gone - God Himself eradicated it, and preserved the honor of His servant.
The fever is gone, the Lord has Himself banished it and saved the honour of His slave.
The fever that has gone — Prabhu Himself, in His grace, wiped it away; Sri Guru Ram Das ji has kept the honour of me, His servant.
WRME: Te = from. Bal jaaee = I am a sacrifice. ||1||

From the society of saints, I have obtained all the boons and to the True Guru, I am a sacrifice.

God has saved me, both here and hereafter. He has not taken my merits and demerits into account.
The Lord has saved me both in this world and the next one and my merits and demerits, He has not taken into account.
The able Guru has set right both this world and the next, and has not weighed any of our virtues or faults. ☬ Again he prays like this:
